title: Three items (chipped coin-dish, smith's tongs, blessed candles) are permanently flagged 'taking it is theft' with the owner 'watching', across ~600 turns, with no payoff ever surfaced for taking or leaving them and no other reference to them anywhere else in the game.
where: The Last Light Inn / The Forge / Gray Chapel
